decisions.reason: Automatic wallet provisioning for fiat minting satisfies the existing wallet prerequisite but does not change Small Block ticket issuance, ownership, eligibility, or lifecycle rules.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the explicitly requested email contents and actions; the Transak automatic-mint destination adds no necessary email-state change.
Automatic minting to a provisioned wallet does not alter the independently specified read-only default, PDF.js technology, or reader entry points.
